# Rules GNU ld 2.42 (BFD, binutils 2.42) applies to an ELF section by NAME,
# outside the default linker script (gnu-ld-2.42-aarch64linux.xdw), for an
# allocated PROGBITS/NOBITS data section on AArch64. Read by
# object_sections::tests::elf_name_rules_match_the_gnu_ld_2_42_default_script,
# which checks the GNU column of object_sections::ELF_NAME_RULES against this
# list and the script: a by-name placement in the table must come from a row
# here, and every row here must be in the table (or be writer-owned).
#
# Fields (whitespace separated): <glob> <effect> [<argument>]
#   The glob uses `*` for any run of characters (possibly empty).
#   parsed <what>   BFD reads every INPUT section whose name matches as
#                   <what>, wherever the script places it (ParsedByName).
#   typed <sh_type> BFD's special-section table types an OUTPUT section of
#                   that name <sh_type>; it decides an orphan's type
#                   (TypedByName). Inside a script statement the statement
#                   decides the placement.
#   owned           the object writer's reserved names already cover it
#                   (object_sections::elf_reserved_reason).
#   inert           BFD has a by-name rule, but it touches only
#                   non-allocated sections, or a NOBITS type that an output
#                   with contents drops, so allocated data keeps its flags.
# First match wins. Rows marked `probe` were linked with trust-cg's section
# type and flags under GNU ld 2.42 as PIE, -no-pie, -z norelro and -shared
# (reports/perf/2026-09-23-linux-explicit-section-write-faults/README.md; its
# records/repair logs are in git history at ea8492fd9315).
#
# binutils 2.42 source of each rule:
#   .eh_frame_entry*  bfd/elflink.c _bfd_elf_parse_eh_frame_entries:
#                     startswith (sec->name, ".eh_frame_entry"), then
#                     bfd/elf-eh-frame.c: "compact frame descriptions
#                     incompatible with DWARF2 .eh_frame" (probe: every
#                     spelling fails the link; .eh_frame_entq links)
#   .eh_frame         bfd/elflink.c bfd_elf_discard_info parses the inputs of
#                     the `.eh_frame` output as CIE/FDE records
#   .rela* .rel .rel.* .relr.dyn   bfd/elf.c special_sections_r (".rela" -1,
#                     ".rel" -2, ".relr.dyn" 0) (probe: .rela_x, .relax,
#                     .relative typed RELA, -shared store faults; .rel.rox
#                     typed REL and .relr.dyn typed RELR, -shared library
#                     unusable; .relx, .relro, .relr, .relr.dynx stay PROGBITS)
#   .stab*str         bfd/elf.c special_sections_s { ".stabstr", 5, 3 }
#                     (prefix `.stab`, suffix `str`) (probe: .stabqstr,
#                     .stabxstr typed STRTAB)
#   .gnu.warning* .gnu.linkonce* .gnu.lto_* .note* .debug* .zdebug* .comment
#                     bfd/elflink.c elf_link_add_object_symbols (.gnu.warning.),
#                     bfd/elf.c _bfd_elf_make_section_from_shdr (.gnu.linkonce,
#                     .debug, .zdebug), special_sections_n (.note -1 SHT_NOTE),
#                     plugin/LTO (.gnu.lto_), special_sections_c (.comment)
#   .line* .stab* .gdb_index   bfd/elf.c _bfd_elf_make_section_from_shdr sets
#                     SEC_DEBUGGING by name for NON-allocated sections only
#                     (probe: .linex, .stabx, .gdb_index allocated data runs)
#   .noinit .persistent .persistent.bss .gnu_object_only .ctf
#                     bfd/elf.c special_sections_{n,p,g,c}; an allocated
#                     output with contents keeps SHT_PROGBITS (probe: all run,
#                     values intact)

.eh_frame_entry*	parsed	compact unwind entries	probe
.eh_frame	owned
.rela*	typed	SHT_RELA	probe
.rel	owned
.rel.*	owned
.relr.dyn	typed	SHT_RELR	probe
.stab*str	typed	SHT_STRTAB	probe
.gnu.warning*	owned
.gnu.linkonce*	owned
.gnu.lto_*	owned
.note*	owned
.debug*	owned
.zdebug*	owned
.comment	owned
.line*	inert	probe
.stab*	inert	probe
.gdb_index	inert	probe
.noinit*	inert	probe
.persistent*	inert	probe
.gnu_object_only*	inert	probe
.ctf*	inert	probe
